title: Antiquity of 'Sail-Backed' Neural Spine Hyper-Elongation in Mammal Forerunners
note: The referred specimen is ROM VP 83326; the paper reports direct comparison with Echinerpeton paratype RM 10057 and type-series casts and photographs.

title: New basal synapsid supports Laurasian origin for therapsids
authors: Liu, J.; Rubidge, B.S.; Li, J.
note: The study describes holotype IVPP V15424 and analyses 71 cranial and dental characters in PAUP; it explicitly notes the lack of reliable radiometric dates for the Dashankou sequence.

title: Mandibular and dental characteristics of Late Triassic mammaliaform Haramiyavia and their ramifications for basal mammal evolution
authors: Luo, Z.-X.; Gatesy, S.M.; Jenkins, F.A. Jr.; Amaral, W.W.; Shubin, N.H.
publisher: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
note: The CT, dental-wear and phylogenetic study uses MCZ7/95A–B and MCZ10/G95; its character data are archived as MorphoBank Project 2292.

title: Brazilian fossils reveal homoplasy in the oldest mammalian jaw joint
authors: Rawson, H.D.; Martinelli, A.G.; Rayfield, E.J.; et al.
note: The study μCT-scanned 26 cynodont specimens, including nine Brasilodon and four highlighted Riograndia specimens; reusable models and matrices are deposited separately under DOI 10.5523/bris.2ie8neiry701e23iayx9gdsytv.

title: Supporting data for Brazilian fossils reveal homoplasy in the oldest mammalian jaw joint
authors: Rawson, H.D.; Martinelli, A.G.; Rayfield, E.J.; et al.
publisher: University of Bristol Research Data Repository
note: Repository record for segmented STL models, videos, CT-derived anatomy and phylogenetic matrices supporting the named Brasilodon and Riograndia sample.

title: Fossils document evolutionary changes of jaw joint to mammalian middle ear
authors: Mao, F.; Zhang, C.; Liu, C.; et al.
note: The comparative anatomical study includes Dianoconodon holotype IVPP V4257 and Feredocodon paratype IMMNH-PV01925; the matrix is MorphoBank Project 5075 and analysis files are archived under DOI 10.5281/zenodo.10597270.

title: Transitional mammalian middle ear from a new Cretaceous Jehol eutriconodont
authors: Meng, J.; Wang, Y.; Li, C.
note: The study is based on the near-complete holotype IVPP V16051 from the Jiufotang Formation and documents its middle-ear and Meckelian anatomy.

title: Meckel's cartilage breakdown offers clues to mammalian middle ear evolution
authors: Anthwal, N.; Urban, D.J.; Luo, Z.-X.; Sears, K.E.; Tucker, A.S.
note: The experimental series compares c-Fos mutant mice with clast-cell inhibition in Monodelphis domestica; it tests cartilage-remodelling mechanisms rather than fossil ancestry.
